visualizations.title: 单比特旋子账本 · 布洛赫球、泡利体积元与旋量双覆盖
visualizations.title_en: Qubit rotor ledger · the Bloch sphere, the Pauli volume element and the spinor double cover
visualizations.summary: 选一个初态 |ψ(θ, φ)⟩，逐个追加单比特门：每个门是一枚 SU(2) 旋子，账本逐步记下布洛赫矢量 r ↦ R r R† 与累积旋子的四个分量，符号带记下旋量落在哪一叶。页面核对 σ₁σ₂σ₃ = i·I₂、H σ₃ H = σ₁ 与 R(2π) = −1，舞台同时画出 A·B 与 A∧B，相图给出 (θ, φ) 上的 ⟨σ⟩。
visualizations.summary_en: Pick an initial state |ψ(θ, φ)⟩ and append single-qubit gates: each gate is an SU(2) rotor, the ledger records the Bloch vector r ↦ R r R† and the four components of the accumulated rotor step by step, and the sign tape records which sheet the spinor is on. The page checks σ₁σ₂σ₃ = i·I₂, H σ₃ H = σ₁ and R(2π) = −1, the stage also draws A·B and A∧B, and the phase map shows ⟨σ⟩ over (θ, φ).

visualizations.title: 对角逃逸、余弦不动点与素数逃逸
visualizations.title_en: Diagonal Escape, the Cosine Fixed Point, and Prime Escape
visualizations.summary: 一张清单 f 列出 N 行二进制串（N = 3 … 8，由种子 S 生成，或在矩阵上逐格点击翻转）。账本逐步读出对角元 f(k, k) 并翻转：d(k) = ¬f(k, k) 在第 k 位与第 k 行不同，所以 d 不在清单里，汉明距离的最小值总是至少为 1——这是 relative_semantic_diagonal_ne_listed_decode 取 latent = id、twist = ¬ 的情形。同一条步进轴推进余弦迭代 xₖ = cos xₖ₋₁ → x* ≈ 0.739085（有限步残差严格为正，并逐步核对 sin²xₖ + cos²xₖ = 1），并列出前 k 个素数、p₁⋯pₖ + 1 不在清单中的最小素因子与有限欧拉积 ∏ (1 − p⁻²)⁻¹ < π²/6。
visualizations.summary_en: A list f holds N binary rows (N = 3 … 8, generated by a seed S, or flipped cell by cell on the matrix). The ledger reads the diagonal entry f(k, k) step by step and flips it: d(k) = ¬f(k, k) differs from row k in place k, so d is not on the list and the smallest Hamming distance is always at least 1 — the case latent = id, twist = ¬ of relative_semantic_diagonal_ne_listed_decode. The same step rail advances the cosine iteration xₖ = cos xₖ₋₁ → x* ≈ 0.739085 (the residual after finitely many steps stays strictly positive, and sin²xₖ + cos²xₖ = 1 is checked at every step) and lists the first k primes, the least prime factor of p₁⋯pₖ + 1, which is not on the list, and the finite Euler product ∏ (1 − p⁻²)⁻¹ < π²/6.

visualizations.title: 佩尔手性账本：±1 接缝、素数分裂与同余数椭圆曲线
visualizations.title_en: Pell Chirality Ledger: the ±1 Seam, Prime Splitting and Congruent-Number Curves
visualizations.summary: 沿 √d（2 ≤ d ≤ 37，无平方因子）的连分数逐步求渐近分数 mₖ/nₖ：账本逐行给出部分商、精确的 BigInt 渐近分数与范数 Δ = mₖ² − d nₖ²；一维误差 |mₖ/nₖ − √d| 趋于 0，二维面积差 |Δ| 却从不小于 1，单位解的范数在 +1 与 −1 之间翻转手性（d = 2 即泰昂边径数 1/1、3/2、7/5、17/12……）。右栏热图逐格画出 m² − d n² 的符号并标出全部 ±1 格，点击即选中最近的渐近步。舞台的另两个视图：素数 p ≡ 1 (mod 4) 在 ℤ[i] 中分裂为 (a + bi)(a − bi)，经拉格朗日—格拉姆恒等式长出勾股三元组 (|a² − b²|, 2ab, p)，p ≡ 3 (mod 4) 保持惰性；同余数曲线 E_d: y² = x³ − d²x 上的有理点给出面积为 d 的有理直角三角形，𝔽ₚ 上逐点计数得到弗罗贝尼乌斯迹 aₚ 与哈塞界 |aₚ| ≤ 2√p。
visualizations.summary_en: Follow the continued fraction of √d (squarefree 2 ≤ d ≤ 37) step by step to the convergents mₖ/nₖ: the ledger lists the partial quotients, the exact BigInt convergents and the norms Δ = mₖ² − d nₖ²; the 1D error |mₖ/nₖ − √d| goes to 0 while the 2D area gap |Δ| never drops below 1, and the unit norms flip their chirality between +1 and −1 (for d = 2, Theon's side and diagonal numbers 1/1, 3/2, 7/5, 17/12, …). The side map draws the sign of m² − d n² cell by cell and marks every ±1 cell; a click picks the nearest convergent step. The stage has two more views: a prime p ≡ 1 (mod 4) splits in ℤ[i] as (a + bi)(a − bi) and, by the Lagrange–Gram identity, grows the Pythagorean triple (|a² − b²|, 2ab, p), while p ≡ 3 (mod 4) stays inert; a rational point on the congruent-number curve E_d: y² = x³ − d²x gives a rational right triangle of area d, and counting points over 𝔽ₚ gives the Frobenius trace aₚ with Hasse's bound |aₚ| ≤ 2√p.

visualizations.title: 无时间因果账本与格拉姆窗口
visualizations.title_en: Timeless causal ledger and the Gram window
visualizations.summary: 给定 c_AB = cos θ₁ 与 c_BC = cos θ₂，第三条余弦只能落在格拉姆窗口 [cos(θ₁ + θ₂), cos(θ₁ − θ₂)] 内：c_AC = c₁c₂ + s₁s₂ cos φ，det G = s₁²s₂² sin²φ ≥ 0，φ = 0 或 π 时贴上 det G = 0 的边界，窗口之外 det G < 0。中间的去序账本逐阶把 (−1)ᵏθ²ᵏ/(2k)! 同时加到三个余弦上，看截断余弦的 det G⁽ᵏ⁾ 怎样越过视界又收敛回真实的一侧；右侧相图画出整片 (θ₁, c_AC) 上的相容透镜。三个视图：格拉姆窗口（球面上的两条小圆、相容椭圆与 det G 抛物线）、晶体书册（HΨ = 0 的 12 页佩奇—伍特斯晶体与泰勒部分和）、P 场 vs NP 线（Klee–Minty 对数势垒的梯度流与耗散恒等式，对照振幅放大每步只转 2θ、逐分量模拟到 t* ≈ (π/4)√(2ⁿ)）；读数另核对 cos²θ + sin²θ = 1 与未读测量下的无信号 Δρ_B = 0。
visualizations.summary_en: Given c_AB = cos θ₁ and c_BC = cos θ₂, the third cosine must lie in the Gram window [cos(θ₁ + θ₂), cos(θ₁ − θ₂)]: c_AC = c₁c₂ + s₁s₂ cos φ, det G = s₁²s₂² sin²φ ≥ 0, the boundary det G = 0 at φ = 0 or π, and det G < 0 outside. The de-ordered ledger in the middle adds (−1)ᵏθ²ᵏ/(2k)! to all three cosines order by order and shows det G⁽ᵏ⁾ of the truncated cosines crossing the horizon and converging back to its true side; the phase map on the right draws the compatible lens over the whole (θ₁, c_AC) plane. Three views: the Gram window (two small circles on the sphere, the compatibility ellipse and the det G parabola), the crystal book (a 12-page Page–Wootters crystal with HΨ = 0 and Taylor partial sums), and P field vs NP thread (a log-barrier gradient flow on Klee–Minty with the dissipation identity, against amplitude amplification turning only 2θ per step, simulated entry by entry up to t* ≈ (π/4)√(2ⁿ)); the readouts also check cos²θ + sin²θ = 1 and no signalling, Δρ_B = 0 under an unread measurement.
